question: There shall be a _______ with the Prime Minister at the head to aid and advise the President of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Council of Ministers**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• There shall be a **Council of Ministers with the Prime Minister** at the head to aid and advise the** President of India**.
 
• **Article 74(1) of the Constitution of India** stipulates that the President of India shall be assisted and advised by a Council of Ministers headed by the Prime Minister.
 
• The President is mandated to act in accordance with the advice tendered by the Council of Ministers.
 
• However, the President retains the prerogative to request the Council of Ministers to review their advice, yet must ultimately adhere to their counsel following reconsideration.
 
• **The 42nd Amendment of the Constitution of India,** enacted in 1976, explicitly delineated that the President is bound to act in accordance with the advice tendered by the Council of Ministers.
 
• This amendment was ratified on** January 3, 1977,** thus solidifying the principle of executive accountability and the supremacy of the Council of Ministers in guiding the President's actions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Council of States,** commonly referred to as the Rajya Sabha, serves as the upper house of the Indian Parliament. As a federal chamber, it holds special powers as outlined in the Constitution.
 
• **An advocate general **of a state holds a senior position within the legal system, providing legal counsel and representation to the state government.
 
• **The Attorney General for India** serves as the principal legal advisor to the Government of India. Appointed by the President of India upon the recommendation of the Union Cabinet in accordance with Article 76(1) of the Constitution, the attorney general holds office at the pleasure of the President.
